answer: Re-attestations are stored in meadow and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the dune graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 697 impostors cost 889 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
